# Knos

> The neutral meter for AI agent work: neither side keeps the count. Pay AI agents only when your checks pass. It runs on Solana devnet, so every payment is test USDC, which is worth nothing.

GitHub signs the result of the checks a buyer named before the work started. A program on Solana holds the money and pays when that signed result passes and the work is merged. Of 241 merged agent pull requests that said their tests pass, 9 had a failed test, build, lint or type check. Knos is open source under the MIT licence.

## Start here

- [The ten-second check](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/check/): paste a public pull request; see whether its checks really passed
- [Questions](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/faq.html): eight short answers, from what Knos is to who holds the money
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drexthealpha/Knos/main/README.md): how it works, in plain words, with diagrams
- [Words](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drexthealpha/Knos/main/docs/WORDS.md): every technical word in one line
